BIG (abbreviation for Berlin International Gaming) is a German esports organization founded on January 2, 2017.

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2017
  • 2018
  • 2019
  • 2020
  • 2021
  • 2022
  • 2023
  • 2024
  • 2025
  • 2026
  • Show All
  • January 2nd - Former NRG trio gob b, LEGIJA, and tabseN announce that they have created a new team called BIG; they also recruit nex and keev to finalize the roster. [1]
  • February 19th - BIG announce the signing of kakafu as their coach. [2]
  • February 5th - BIG bench keev. LEGIJA becomes the coach and head of the CS:GO team, while kakafu becomes their analyst. [3]
  • February 11th - BIG acquire tiziaN from ALTERNATE aTTaX and extend the trial period for luckeRRR. [4]
  • April 3rd - BIG part ways with luckeRRR after deciding not to extend the trial period. [5]
  • April 21st - BIG acquire smooya from Epsilon eSports. [6]
  • December 23rd - BIG sign XANTARES to replace nex for the latter to undergo medical treatment for wrist pains. [7]
  • February 1st - smooya steps down from the active roster; nex returns. [8]
  • May 15th - BIG bench nex due to ongoing health issues and replace him with denis. [9]
  • August 2nd - gob b retires from competitive play and replaces LEGIJA as the head of CS:GO team. smooya and nex are brought back to the lineup while denis is benched. LEGIJA stands in for nex until he fully recovers. Additionally, kakafu steps down as coach. [10][11]
  • August 15th - BIG unveil tow b as their new coach. [12]
  • September 1st - denis is acquired by Sprout. [13]
  • January 1st - BIG revamp their roster with the addition of syrsoN and k1to, replacing nex and smooya. gob b replaces LEGIJA as the head of the team. [14]
  • July 17th - gob b transitions into VALORANT and leaves his organizational post. [15]
  • September 1st - zonixx transitions into being a VALORANT player for BIG. [16]
  • September 28th - XANTARES signs a one-year contract extension with BIG, keeping him tied to the organization until the end of 2021. [17]
  • October 6th - BIG sign DuDe as an assistant coach. [18]
  • January 9th - tow b steps down from the team, DuDe is promoted to head coach. [19]
  • July 31st - BIG sign gade. [20]
  • August 1st - BIG place XANTARES on the transfer list. [21]
  • August 13th - XANTARES is released from his contract and signed by Eternal Fire. [22][23]
  • September 15th - LEGIJA steps in as interim coach as DuDe takes a personal leave. [24]
  • November 10th - BIG part ways with LEGIJA and sign enkay J as their new head coach. [25]
  • December 27th - BIG bench gade and acquire faveN from Sprout as his replacement. [26]
  • January 12th - BIG hire Roman R. as the organization's Chief of CS:GO. [27]
  • January 18th - BIG sign jansen as an analyst. [28]
  • March 19th - BIG demote k1to to BIG Academy and promote Krimbo on trial to replace him. [29]
  • May 1st - gob b is transferred over from their VALORANT division as their new head coach. [30]
  • May 13th - BIG part ways with enkay J. [31]
  • July 18th - BIG sign Krimbo on a permanent basis. [32]
  • July 29th - tabseN and gob b renew their contracts with BIG, keeping them tied to the organization until 2027. [33]
  • August 2nd - gade is released from his contract with BIG. [34]
  • August 9th - k1to returns to the main roster from BIG Academy while tiziaN steps down from the active lineup to assume an unspecified role within the organization. [35]
  • January 6th - BIG part ways with jansen. [36]
  • February 20th - BIG bench syrsoN and promote hyped from BIG Academy. [37]
  • June 21st - BIG bench faveN and k1to, move hyped back to BIG Academy whilst promoting prosus and s1n, and sign mantuu. Additionally, DuDe is re-signed as their assistant coach. [38]
  • June 30th - k1to is acquired by OG. [39]
  • July 3rd - BIG release tiziaN. [40]
  • August 15th - syrsoN is acquired by an undisclosed organization, later revealed to be 00 Nation. [41][42]
  • October 13th - BIG sign zonixx as a content creator. [43]
  • November 2nd - prosus signs a multi-year contract extension with BIG. [44]
  • December 11th - Krimbo signs a multi-year contract extension with BIG. [45]
  • December 27th - faveN is acquired by an undisclosed organization, later revealed to be BLEED Esports. [46]
  • February 12th - BIG bench s1n and mantuu and acquire syrsoN and JDC from 00 Nation as their replacements. [47]
  • February 29th - BIG sign kakafu as an assistant coach. [48]
  • March 26th - s1n is acquired by M80. [49]
  • May 21st - mantuu is acquired by an undisclosed organization, later revealed to be 9INE. [50]
  • May 25th - BIG bench gob b while kakafu takes over as interim coach. [51]
  • July 10th - BIG bench prosus and sign rigoN as his replacement. [52]
  • July 18th - BIG sign tow b as a performance coach. [53]
  • December 30th - BIG bench syrsoN. [54]
  • December 31st - BIG part ways with rigoN. [55]
  • January 1st - BIG part ways with sAu. [56]
  • January 10th - BIG acquire kyuubii from Fnatic and promote hyped from the academy. [57]
  • January 15th - BIG part ways with DuDe. [58]
  • January 23rd - BIG sign xenn as an assistant coach. [59]
  • February 12th - BIG release syrsoN. [60]
  • March 17th - BIG bench kakafu while xenn takes over as interim coach. [61]
  • June 23rd - BIG part ways with kakafu following the expiration of his contract. [62]
  • July 2nd - BIG demote prosus to the academy team. Additionally, xenn returns to an assistant coach position. [63]
  • July 8th - BIG add ScrunK as coach on a trial basis. [64]
  • August 22nd - BIG demote kyuubii to the academy team while promoting prosus and FreeZe to the main team, the latter as an assistant coach. Additionally, they bench ScrunK while xenn takes over as head coach. [65][66][67]
  • August 31st - BIG transfer gob b to the academy team. [68]
  • October 1st - BIG part ways with ScrunK following the expiration of his contract. [69]
  • October 10th - BIG bench hyped and acquire gr1ks from HEROIC as his replacement. [70][71]
  • October 12th - BIG bench Krimbo and move FreeZe to a player position as his replacement. [72]
  • January 3rd - BIG release hyped. [73]
  • January 4th - BIG part ways with FreeZe. [74]
  • January 9th - BIG demote prosus to the academy team, acquire blameF from Fnatic, and sign faveN and tiziaN, the latter as an assistant coach. [75][76][77]
  • September 2nd - BIG loan Krimbo to Ninjas in Pyjamas until the end of the year. [78]
